# Hindustan Times Auto (HT Auto)

> > India's leading automotive news platform covering electric vehicles, car launches, industry trends, and market analysis with focus on brands like Tesla, Mahindra, BMW, and Tata Motors.

HT Auto is the automotive vertical of Hindustan Times, providing comprehensive coverage of the Indian and global automotive industry. The platform specializes in electric vehicle developments, new car launches, market trends, and automotive policy updates with particular emphasis on India's growing EV market and major players like Mahindra, Tesla, and BMW.

## Key Topics

- Electric Vehicles (EVs)
- Tesla India Entry
- Mahindra Electric (BE 6, XEV 9e, XUV 7XO)
- BMW India & Premium EV Market
- Tata Motors Electric Vehicles
- China EV Market & Price Wars
- Hyundai i20 N Line
- Mahindra Bolero Neo
- Indian Automotive Industry
- EV Sales & Market Trends
- Luxury Car Competition
- Electric Vehicle Launches
- Automotive Policy & Regulations
- Vehicle Imports & Exports

- [Tata Motors teases a new EV which will be uncovered tomorrow.
